name: NS Remove Related Products for WooCommerce
author: NsThemes

sections.description:
Want to remove related products in WooCommerce? Whether they distract your customers, clutter your product pages, or simply don’t fit your store’s strategy, NS Remove Related Products gives you full control — with zero configuration and zero coding required.

Install, activate, and the related products section is gone. It’s that simple. Already used by thousands of WooCommerce stores worldwide.

Why remove or control related products?

Related products can be a useful upsell tool — but not always. On focused product pages they create distraction. In large catalogs they’re often irrelevant or random. For stores with a curated customer journey, they break the flow. This plugin lets you decide what’s right for your store, without touching a single line of code.

Need more control? Upgrade to Premium.

The free version removes related products globally in one click. If you need finer control — showing them only to certain users, overriding settings per product, or customizing how many appear and in what order — the Premium version gives you everything you need:

  • Enable / Disable the plugin with a single click, without deactivating it
  • Audience targeting — show related products to all visitors, to registered users only, or hide them entirely
  • Per-product override — set a custom rule directly on individual product pages
  • Number of products — choose exactly how many related products to display
  • Order By — sort by date, title, random order, and more
  • Ascending / Descending — full control over sorting direction

Discover the Premium version →

Compatibility

We continuously test our plugins for compatibility with the most popular WordPress themes and plugins. Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and PHP 8.5. If you find an incompatibility with a specific plugin or theme, please let us know at report@nsthemes.com and we will look into it as quickly as possible.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire ‘ns-remove-related-product-for-woocommerce’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Do I need to write code to use this plugin?

No. NS Remove Related Products works out of the box — install, activate, done. No coding required.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active to use this plugin.

Can I hide related products only for certain users?

Yes, with the Premium version you can show related products to all visitors, to registered users only, or hide them entirely.

Can I override the setting on a single product?

Yes, the Premium version allows you to set a custom rule directly on each individual product page, overriding the global setting.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, version 3.0.0 includes full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
